text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuuu*~, I did my best~.
I really did my best, but~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Fukukitaru, you are quite fast~.
It felt like you just went whooosh~...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry about that! I went ahead and finished first!
Man, it really felt like I kept rolling sixes on the dice the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I even rolled a 10 or 20?
Either way, my crazy luck went off☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Luck... Who knew you were
this strong at it...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Is your luck... that strong?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see! Maybe that proverb
was right after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: What's that saying again~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
They say the Kikuka-sho is won by the "strongest" Umamusume!
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The "luckiest" Umamusume will win!
...Don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I see~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She claims it was luck, but clearly there was
more to it. Mejiro Bright fought bravely,
but came up short against Matikane Fukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That night—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, although we were defeated,
we somehow managed to engrave the Mejiro hoofprints
here in Kyoto~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Long-distance races are quite enjoyable, aren't they~? Unlike medium distances, this has its own charm as well~.
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's got a different kind of fun to it, huh?
Yeah, it has a different kind of charm, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking back on the race, we discuss future plans.
We now know she can hold her own
even in a 3,000m race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, focusing primarily on long distances
is one option. But to make the most of her sharp turn of foot,
returning to medium distances is also...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what I desire is what the Mejiro family desires.
Therefore~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I don't think there's anything to hesitate about~. The Tenno Sho (Spring) is the only race truly fitting for a Mejiro, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Mejiro Bright can clearly see
the path ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the Kikuka Sho to the Tenno Sho (Spring).
Still, will that hold up against the Senior long-distance ranks, in the pinnacle of all long-distance races...?

If you cannot decide,
you should try it out first.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Lady McQueen~!
And Lady Ryan~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Where does Bright's true strength lie,
freely commanding the best distances of both Ryan and myself?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Isn't there a race perfectly suited
for putting your talents as a stayer to the test?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The perfect race. In other words...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's the country's longest at 3,600m. And a GII mixed with Senior Class runners at that. If I can put up a good fight there, too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She is undoubtedly a true stayer.
Wouldn't you agree, Ryan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I also feel like we shouldn't
limit Bright's potential.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"So, how about watching over them there?
If Trainer agrees, that is..."
choice_data_list: ...All right. Let's go with the Stayers Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~ It's such a ve~ry
long race, isn't it~? I'm quite looking forward to it~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Stayers Stakes.
An ultra-long-distance race that stands unique in the Twinkle Series. That is precisely why..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: We might be able to unravel the mystery behind Mejiro Bright's curious talent there.
